examTags: 阅读·根据外形识别动物
grammar: n. 狐狸；可数，复数 foxes。
collocations: a red fox; a fox in the forest; foxes live in the wild。
commonMistake: fox 的复数加 -es：foxes；不要写 foxs。

example.english: A fox is looking for food near the trees.
example.chinese: 一只狐狸正在树丛附近寻找食物。

application.prompt: This wild animal has a pointed face and a bushy tail. It is a ___. A. fox B. whale
application.solution: A。解析：尖尖的脸和蓬松尾巴是狐狸的典型外形特征。

examTags: 阅读·根据身体特征识别动物
grammar: n. 长颈鹿；可数，复数 giraffes。
collocations: a tall giraffe; a giraffe's long neck; giraffes eat leaves。
commonMistake: giraffe 的复数是 giraffes；注意拼写中有两个 f。

example.english: The giraffe can reach leaves high in the trees.
example.chinese: 长颈鹿能够够到高处树上的叶子。

application.prompt: Which animal has a very long neck? A. giraffe B. penguin
application.solution: A。解析：长颈鹿最显著的身体特征是长脖子。

examTags: 阅读·根据动物特征获取信息
grammar: n. 雕；鹰；可数，复数 eagles。
collocations: a golden eagle; an eagle's wings; eagles fly high。
commonMistake: eagle 是可数名词，单数前通常用 an：an eagle。

example.english: An eagle circles high above the mountain.
example.chinese: 一只鹰在山上空盘旋。

application.prompt: Choose the bird of prey: A. eagle B. sandwich
application.solution: A。解析：eagle 是鹰类鸟；sandwich 是三明治。

grammar: n. 狼；可数，复数 wolves，属于 f/fe 变 ves 的不规则拼写。
collocations: a grey wolf; a pack of wolves; wolves live in forests。
commonMistake: wolf 的复数是 wolves，不是 wolfs；注意 f 变 v 后加 -es。

example.english: Wolves often live and hunt in groups.
example.chinese: 狼常常成群生活和捕猎。

application.prompt: There are two ___ in the picture. A. wolves B. wolfs
application.solution: A。解析：wolf 的不规则复数形式是 wolves。

examTags: 阅读·栖息地与动物习性
grammar: n. 企鹅；可数，复数 penguins。企鹅是鸟类，但不会飞，善于游泳。
collocations: a penguin colony; penguins swim; penguins in Antarctica。
commonMistake: penguin 是可数名词；单数前用 a，复数加 -s：a penguin / penguins。

example.english: The penguins swim quickly in the cold sea.
example.chinese: 企鹅在寒冷的海水中游得很快。

application.prompt: These birds cannot fly, but swim well and live in cold regions. They are ___. A. penguins B. eagles
application.solution: A。解析：不会飞、善游泳的鸟是 penguins（企鹅）。

grammar: n. 照顾；护理；关心；v. 关心、在乎。常用 care for（照料/喜欢）和 care about（关心）。
collocations: take care; care for an animal; care about wildlife。
commonMistake: care 作动词时常说 care about sb./sth.；照料某人或动物可说 care for sb./sth.。

example.english: People should care about wild animals and their homes.
example.chinese: 人们应该关心野生动物和它们的家园。

application.prompt: Mina feeds and protects an injured bird. She takes ___ of it. A. care B. danger
application.solution: A。解析：take care of 表示“照顾”。

examTags: 语言运用·表达照料行为
grammar: phr. 照顾；处理。后接名词或代词作宾语；代词放在 of 后，如 take care of them。
collocations: take care of a pet; take good care of; take care of the problem。
commonMistake: 短语中 of 不能省略；代词放在短语后：take care of it，不说 take care it。

example.english: The volunteers take care of the rescued penguins.
example.chinese: 志愿者照顾获救的企鹅。

application.prompt: The young fox has no parent nearby. The wildlife team will ___ it. A. take care of B. cut down
application.solution: A。解析：照料小狐狸用 take care of；cut down 表示砍倒或减少。

grammar: n. 三明治；可数，复数 sandwiches。
collocations: a cheese sandwich; make a sandwich; two sandwiches。
commonMistake: sandwich 的复数加 -es：sandwiches；单数前用 a。

example.english: I packed a sandwich for the long trip.
example.chinese: 我为这趟长途旅行准备了一个三明治。

application.prompt: Bread with cheese and vegetables between the slices is a ___. A. sandwich B. snake
application.solution: A。解析：夹有馅料的两片面包组成 sandwich（三明治）。

examTags: 阅读·根据外形识别动物
grammar: n. 蛇；可数，复数 snakes。
collocations: a long snake; a snake in the grass; snakes crawl。
commonMistake: snake 是可数名词；表示一种蛇时用 a snake，多个用 snakes。

example.english: A small snake is resting under a rock.
example.chinese: 一条小蛇正在岩石下面休息。

application.prompt: This long animal has no legs and moves along the ground. It is a ___. A. snake B. giraffe
application.solution: A。解析：蛇没有腿，靠身体移动。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与情感表达
阅读·区分事物特点和人的感受
grammar: adj. 吓人的；恐怖的。比较级 scarier，最高级 scariest。
collocations: a scary story; a scary animal; look scary。
commonMistake: scary 描述“令人害怕的事物”；scared 描述“感到害怕的人”。

example.english: The dark cave looks scary, but it is safe to enter with a guide.
example.chinese: 黑暗的洞穴看起来吓人，但有向导陪同进入是安全的。

application.prompt: The loud thunder made Sam feel ___. A. scared B. scary
application.solution: A。解析：Sam 是感到害怕的人，用 scared；引起害怕的事物用 scary。

examTags: 阅读·理解动物身体特征
grammar: n. 脖子；颈部；可数，复数 necks。
collocations: a long neck; turn your neck; around the neck。
commonMistake: neck 指连接头和身体的颈部；不要与 knee（膝盖）混淆拼写和意思。

example.english: A giraffe uses its long neck to reach leaves.
example.chinese: 长颈鹿用它的长脖子够到树叶。

application.prompt: The body part between your head and shoulders is your ___. A. neck B. trunk
application.solution: A。解析：头和肩膀之间的部位是 neck（脖子）。

grammar: v. 猜测；估计；guess—guessed—guessed—guessing。可接答案、数字或疑问词引导的从句。
collocations: guess the answer; guess how many; guess at a number。
commonMistake: guess 的过去式和过去分词加 -ed：guessed；第三人称单数是 guesses。

example.english: Can you guess how many penguins are on the ice?
example.chinese: 你能猜出冰面上有多少只企鹅吗？

application.prompt: I do not know the answer, so I will ___ it. A. guess B. carry
application.solution: A。解析：不知道答案时可以 guess（猜测）。

examTags: 阅读·动物特征与栖息地
grammar: n. 鲨鱼；可数，复数 sharks。
collocations: a large shark; a shark in the sea; shark species。
commonMistake: shark 是可数名词；与 whale 区分时可根据体形、呼吸和哺乳等信息判断。

example.english: The shark swims through the deep water.
example.chinese: 鲨鱼游过深水区。

application.prompt: This large sea fish has a strong tail and several rows of teeth. It is a ___. A. shark B. penguin
application.solution: A。解析：鲨鱼是有多排牙齿的海洋鱼类；企鹅是鸟类。

grammar: n. 鲸；可数，复数 whales。鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼。
collocations: a blue whale; a whale in the ocean; whales breathe air。
commonMistake: whale 虽生活在海里，却是哺乳动物；注意与 shark（鲨鱼）区分。

example.english: A whale comes to the surface to breathe air.
example.chinese: 鲸会浮到水面呼吸空气。

application.prompt: This huge sea animal breathes air and feeds its baby milk. It is a ___. A. whale B. shark
application.solution: A。解析：鲸是哺乳动物，会用肺呼吸并哺育幼崽。

grammar: adj. 巨大的；极多的。可作定语或表语；比较时可用 huge 或 very large 表示程度。
collocations: a huge animal; a huge amount; a huge difference。
commonMistake: huge 是形容词，常放在名词前，如 a huge whale；副词形式是 hugely。

example.english: A blue whale is a huge animal.
example.chinese: 蓝鲸是一种巨大的动物。

application.prompt: The elephant is very large. It is a ___ animal. A. huge B. tiny
application.solution: A。解析：huge 表示“巨大的”，tiny 表示“极小的”。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与名词派生
grammar: adj. 危险的；有危害的。常用 be dangerous to sb./sth.；名词是 danger。
collocations: a dangerous animal; dangerous to people; a dangerous road。
commonMistake: dangerous 是形容词，修饰人或事物；danger 是名词，如 be in danger。

example.english: It can be dangerous to approach a wild animal.
example.chinese: 靠近野生动物可能很危险。

application.prompt: The broken bridge is not safe to cross. It is ___. A. dangerous B. playful
application.solution: A。解析：不安全、可能造成伤害的东西是 dangerous（危险的）。

examTags: 阅读·动物保护与资源保存
grammar: v. 救；储蓄；保存。规则变化 save—saved—saved—saving；可接人、动物、钱或文件作宾语。
collocations: save an animal; save money; save a file。
commonMistake: save 可指救助、储蓄或保存；根据宾语判断词义，如 save a life 与 save money。

example.english: The rescue team works to save injured wild animals.
example.chinese: 救援队努力救助受伤的野生动物。

application.prompt: The forest team takes an injured fox to a safe place to ___. A. save it B. kill it
application.solution: A。解析：把受伤的狐狸带到安全地点是为了救助它，用 save。

examTags: 词汇·不可数名词与祝愿表达
grammar: n. 幸运；运气；通常不可数。常说 good luck、bad luck、luckily（幸运地）。
collocations: good luck; have good luck; a bit of luck。
commonMistake: luck 通常不可数，不说 a luck；祝愿别人可说 Good luck!。

example.english: Good luck with your animal report!
example.chinese: 祝你的动物报告顺利！

application.prompt: Your friend is going to give a speech. You say, “Good ___!” A. luck B. danger
application.solution: A。解析：Good luck! 是祝别人顺利的常用表达。

grammar: adj./n. 泰国的；泰国人的；泰国人；泰语。国籍和语言名称首字母大写；表示语言时通常不可数。
collocations: Thai food; Thai language; Thai people。
commonMistake: Thai 作国籍形容词、名词或语言名称时首字母都大写；不要把 Thai 和 Thailand 混淆。

example.english: Malee teaches us a few Thai words.
example.chinese: Malee 教我们几个泰语单词。

application.prompt: The language spoken in Thailand is ___. A. Thai B. Thailand
application.solution: A。解析：Thai 可表示泰语；Thailand 是国家名“泰国”。

grammar: n. 象鼻；可数，复数 trunks。trunk 也可指树干或汽车后备箱，需结合语境判断。
collocations: an elephant's trunk; a long trunk; use its trunk。
commonMistake: trunk 可表示象鼻、树干或后备箱；和 elephant 连用时通常指象鼻。

example.english: The elephant uses its trunk to pick up a branch.
example.chinese: 大象用它的象鼻捡起一根树枝。

application.prompt: An elephant uses this long body part to drink water. It is its ___. A. trunk B. neck
application.solution: A。解析：大象用 trunk（象鼻）吸水和抓取物品。

grammar: v. 捡；摘；挑选。pick—picked—picked—picking；pick flowers/fruit 表示采摘，pick a book 表示挑选。
collocations: pick flowers; pick fruit; pick a name。
commonMistake: pick 表示“捡起”时常用 pick up；pick flowers 表示“采花”，不要误加 up。

example.english: The apples are ripe, so the farmer picks them from the trees.
example.chinese: 苹果熟了，所以农民把它们从树上摘下来。

application.prompt: The apples are ripe, so the farmer will ___ them from the trees. A. pick B. carry
application.solution: A。解析：从树上采摘水果用 pick。

examTags: 词汇·动词短语与宾语位置
grammar: phr. 捡起；举起。宾语可放在 up 前或后；代词必须放在中间：pick it up。
collocations: pick up a bag; pick the book up; pick it up。
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时必须放中间：pick it up；不说 pick up it。

example.english: Please pick up the paper near the door.
example.chinese: 请捡起门边的纸。

application.prompt: The bottle is on the floor. Please pick ___ up. A. it B. up it
application.solution: A。解析：动词短语接代词时，代词放在 pick 和 up 之间。

grammar: v. 搬运；携带。常接物品作宾语，也可表示抱、背着。
collocations: carry a bag; carry a box; carry a baby
commonMistake: carry 表示把物品带在身上或搬运；“捡起”强调动作，可用 pick up。

example.english: The keeper carries food to the young foxes.
example.chinese: 饲养员把食物送给小狐狸。

application.prompt: Mia has a heavy box in her hands. She can ___ it to the car. A. carry B. hear
application.solution: A。解析：把箱子搬到车上用 carry。

grammar: adj. 爱玩的；活泼的。可放在名词前，也可放在 be、look 等词后。
collocations: a playful puppy; playful animals; look playful
commonMistake: playful 是形容词；描述动物“正在玩”可用 playing。

example.english: The playful dolphins follow the boat.
example.chinese: 活泼的海豚跟着小船游。

application.prompt: The young otter runs and plays all day. It is ___. A. playful B. dangerous
application.solution: A。解析：喜欢玩、活泼的用 playful。

grammar: n. 游泳者；善于游泳的动物。由 swim + -er 构成，指做游泳动作的人或动物。
collocations: a strong swimmer; a fast swimmer; a good swimmer
commonMistake: swimmer 指游泳者；swimming 可作“游泳”或现在分词。

example.english: A seal is a strong swimmer.
example.chinese: 海豹很擅长游泳。

application.prompt: A person who swims is a ___. A. swimmer B. forest
application.solution: A。解析：swimmer 是“游泳者”。

grammar: phr. 彼此；互相。作动词的宾语，表示两个或多个人相互做某事。
collocations: help one another; know one another; talk to one another
commonMistake: one another 表示“彼此”；不要误写成 another one（另一个）。

example.english: The young animals stay close to one another.
example.chinese: 小动物们彼此靠在一起。

application.prompt: The two classmates help ___. A. one another B. another one
application.solution: A。解析：表示两人互相帮助用 one another。

grammar: phr. 照料；照看。后接人或物作宾语，宾语放在 after 后。
collocations: look after a child; look after a pet; look after yourself
commonMistake: look after 是固定搭配，不能把宾语放在 look 和 after 之间。

example.english: The rescue team looks after the injured bird.
example.chinese: 救援队照料这只受伤的鸟。

application.prompt: Please look ___ the puppy while I get its food. A. after B. at
application.solution: A。解析：照料小狗用 look after。

grammar: n. 文化。通常作不可数名词；说不同的文化时可用 cultures。
collocations: local culture; animal culture; learn about a culture
commonMistake: culture 表示“文化”时通常不加 a；特指一种文化时可说 a culture。

example.english: The museum teaches us about the culture of the region.
example.chinese: 博物馆让我们了解这个地区的文化。

application.prompt: We can learn about local ___ at the museum. A. culture B. cultures of one
application.solution: A。解析：此处 culture 泛指文化，通常用不可数形式。

grammar: adv. 然而；不过。用于连接意思相反或不同的句子，常放句首并用逗号隔开。
collocations: However, ...; ..., however, ...
commonMistake: however 不能像 but 一样直接把两个完整句子连在一起；句首常写“However, ...”。

example.english: The forest looks quiet. However, many birds live there.
example.chinese: 森林看起来很安静。不过，那里住着许多鸟。

application.prompt: The path is long. ___, we can reach the lake before noon. A. However B. Because
application.solution: A。解析：前后形成转折，用 However。

grammar: n. 危险。常作不可数名词；常见结构有 in danger 和 out of danger。
collocations: be in danger; face danger; out of danger
commonMistake: 说“处于危险中”用 in danger，不说 in a danger。

example.english: Plastic waste can put sea animals in danger.
example.chinese: 塑料垃圾会使海洋动物陷入危险。

application.prompt: The baby bird cannot fly and is ___ danger. A. in B. on
application.solution: A。解析：固定搭配是 in danger。

grammar: phr. 处于危险中。常用 be in danger；danger 前通常不加冠词。
collocations: be in danger; put ... in danger; animals in danger
commonMistake: 固定说 in danger；不要说 in the danger 来表示一般的危险。

example.english: Some sea turtles are in danger because of fishing nets.
example.chinese: 一些海龟因渔网而处于危险中。

application.prompt: The sign says the old bridge is unsafe. People who cross it are ___. A. in danger B. in a danger
application.solution: A。解析：固定表达为 in danger。

grammar: n. 森林。是可数名词，单数前通常要有限定词，复数为 forests。
collocations: a forest; a tropical forest; forest animals
commonMistake: forest 是可数名词，泛指一片森林可说 a forest。

example.english: Many wild animals find food in the forest.
example.chinese: 许多野生动物在森林里寻找食物。

application.prompt: We walked through ___ forest to watch birds. A. a B. an
application.solution: A。解析：forest 是以辅音音素开头的可数名词单数，用 a。

grammar: phr. 砍倒；减少。宾语为代词时放在 cut 和 down 之间，如 cut them down。
collocations: cut down a tree; cut down trees; cut down on waste
commonMistake: 表示砍倒树时是 cut down a tree；宾语为代词要说 cut it down。

example.english: People should not cut down trees in this forest.
example.chinese: 人们不应该砍伐这片森林里的树木。

application.prompt: The trees are old. Please do not cut ___ down. A. them B. down them
application.solution: A。解析：cut down 接代词时，代词放在中间。

grammar: phr. 太多。后接可数名词复数；修饰不可数名词用 too much。
collocations: too many cars; too many bags; too much noise
commonMistake: too many 后接可数名词复数；不可数名词前用 too much。

example.english: Too many lights can disturb birds at night.
example.chinese: 夜间太多灯光会打扰鸟类。

application.prompt: There are ___ plastic bottles on the beach. A. too many B. too much
application.solution: A。解析：bottles 是可数名词复数，用 too many。

grammar: v. 杀死；导致死亡。过去式和过去分词为 killed；可直接接人或动物作宾语。
collocations: kill an animal; kill insects; be killed by
commonMistake: kill 是动词，描述已经发生的事用 killed；不要把 killed 和 kill 混用。

example.english: We should never kill wild animals for fun.
example.chinese: 我们绝不应该为了好玩而杀害野生动物。

application.prompt: The past form of kill is ___. A. killed B. kill
application.solution: A。解析：kill 是规则动词，过去式加 -ed。

grammar: phr. 由……制成。be made of 后接材料，材料仍能看出；be made from 常用于原料经过加工后看不出原样。
collocations: be made of wood; be made of cotton; a table made of glass
commonMistake: 说明成品由什么材料制成用 be made of；注意根据主语选 is、are 或 was。

example.english: This small model is made of paper.
example.chinese: 这个小模型是用纸做的。

application.prompt: We can still see the wood in this desk. It is ___ wood. A. made of B. made in
application.solution: A。解析：看得出材料是木头，用 be made of。

grammar: n. 象牙。通常作不可数名词；也可指象牙色。
collocations: ivory trade; ivory products; ivory-coloured
commonMistake: ivory 表示材料“象牙”时通常不可数，不说 an ivory；象牙制品不能成为伤害野生动物的理由。

example.english: Elephants need protection from the illegal ivory trade.
example.chinese: 大象需要得到保护，免受非法象牙贸易的伤害。

application.prompt: Elephants are killed for ___. A. ivory B. an ivory
application.solution: A。解析：ivory 表示象牙材料时通常不可数，不加 a/an。

grammar: adj. 友好的。可修饰名词，也可作表语；常见结构 be friendly to sb。
collocations: a friendly animal; be friendly to visitors; a friendly smile
commonMistake: friendly 虽以 -ly 结尾，却是形容词；副词形式是 in a friendly way。

example.english: The guide is friendly to visitors at the wildlife park.
example.chinese: 野生动物园的向导对游客很友好。

application.prompt: The new keeper is kind to every animal. He is ___ to them. A. friendly B. friend
application.solution: A。解析：be 后需用形容词 friendly，且搭配 friendly to。

grammar: adv. 相当；很；完全。常放在形容词或副词前；具体程度要结合语境判断。
collocations: quite large; quite dangerous; quite well
commonMistake: quite 修饰形容词时通常放在其前面：quite big；不要误放在形容词后。

example.english: The whale is quite large, but it is gentle.
example.chinese: 这头鲸相当大，但它很温和。

application.prompt: The path is not small; it is ___ wide. A. quite B. quite a
application.solution: A。解析：wide 是形容词，前面用 quite；quite a 后应接名词短语。

examTags: 语法·冠词与形容词顺序
grammar: phr. 相当……的一个。结构为 quite a/an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词。
collocations: quite a big animal; quite a long trip; quite an interesting book
commonMistake: quite a/an 后接形容词和单数可数名词；形容词以元音音素开头时用 an。

example.english: A giraffe has quite a long neck.
example.chinese: 长颈鹿的脖子相当长。

application.prompt: It is ___ unusual animal. A. quite an B. quite a
application.solution: A。解析：unusual 以元音音素开头，用 an。

grammar: phr. 一点也不；完全不。not 放在助动词或 be 后，at all 常放在句末加强否定。
collocations: not like ... at all; not dangerous at all; do not worry at all
commonMistake: not ... at all 表否定；句中已有 not，不要再加 never 表达同一层否定。

example.english: This quiet rabbit is not scary at all.
example.chinese: 这只安静的兔子一点也不可怕。

application.prompt: The animal is very calm. It is ___ scary at all. A. not B. no
application.solution: A。解析：固定否定表达为 not ... at all。

grammar: n. （动物的）软毛；毛皮。表示动物的毛时通常不可数；表示毛皮衣物或种类时可数。
collocations: thick fur; soft fur; a fur coat
commonMistake: 描述动物身上的毛通常说 fur，不用 hairs；fur 作“毛”时一般不加复数 -s。

example.english: The fox grows thick fur before winter.
example.chinese: 狐狸在冬天来临前长出浓密的毛。

application.prompt: A fox has soft ___. A. fur B. furs
application.solution: A。解析：这里泛指动物身上的毛，fur 通常不可数。

grammar: adj. 失明的；看不见的。常作表语，也可作定语；描述人时可用 blind people。
collocations: be blind; a blind person; blind animals
commonMistake: blind 是形容词；“失明”可说 be blind，不要误用名词 blindness。

example.english: The rescued dog is blind, so it needs a safe home.
example.chinese: 这只获救的狗失明了，所以它需要一个安全的家。

application.prompt: A person who cannot see is ___. A. blind B. hearing
application.solution: A。解析：blind 表示失明的；hearing 与听觉有关。

grammar: n. 听力；听觉。表示听觉能力时通常不可数；也可指正式听证会。
collocations: good hearing; lose one's hearing; hearing problems
commonMistake: 表示“听力”时用 hearing；hear 是动词，意为“听见”。

example.english: Owls have good hearing and can find food at night.
example.chinese: 猫头鹰听觉灵敏，夜间也能找到食物。

application.prompt: The noun meaning the ability to hear is ___. A. hearing B. hear
application.solution: A。解析：hear 是动词；hearing 可作“听力、听觉”。

grammar: n. 南极洲。专有地名，首字母大写；通常不与 the 连用。
collocations: in Antarctica; the Antarctic region; Antarctica's wildlife
commonMistake: Antarctica 是洲名，首字母必须大写；表示“在南极洲”常说 in Antarctica。

example.english: Penguins live in Antarctica and other southern regions.
example.chinese: 企鹅生活在南极洲和其他南部地区。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written continent: A. Antarctica B. antarctica
application.solution: A。解析：专有地名 Antarctica 的首字母要大写。

grammar: n. 非洲。专有地名，首字母大写；通常不与 the 连用。
collocations: in Africa; African animals; across Africa
commonMistake: Africa 是洲名，写作 Africa；表示“非洲的”常用形容词 African。

example.english: Many giraffes live in Africa.
example.chinese: 许多长颈鹿生活在非洲。

application.prompt: The adjective for something from Africa is ___. A. African B. Africa
application.solution: A。解析：Africa 是名词地名；African 是形容词，意为“非洲的”。

grammar: n. 玛莉（人名）。人名首字母大写；通常不与 a/an 或 the 连用。
collocations: Malee's family; meet Malee; ask Malee
commonMistake: Malee 是人名，首字母大写；表示所属关系可写 Malee's。

example.english: Malee helps the animal-care team after school.
example.chinese: 放学后，玛莉帮助动物护理小组。

application.prompt: Choose the correct spelling of the name: A. Malee B. malee
application.solution: A。解析：人名是专有名词，首字母大写。

grammar: n. 泰国。国家名称，首字母大写；表示“泰国的/泰国人”常用 Thai。
collocations: in Thailand; travel to Thailand; Thai culture
commonMistake: Thailand 是国家名；Thai 可作形容词或名词，不能把二者当作同一个词性使用。

example.english: The class reads about elephants in Thailand.
example.chinese: 全班阅读有关泰国大象的资料。

application.prompt: The country is ___. A. Thailand B. Thai
application.solution: A。解析：Thailand 是国家名；Thai 表示“泰国的”或“泰国人/泰语”。
